name: AIONS Session Finalizer
description: Wymusza zapisanie kontekstu przed zakończeniem sesji

actions.content:
## 📝 SESSION END CHECKLIST

Before ending this session, you MUST:

1. Call `conv_log('assistant', 'Session summary: [what was done]')` with summary
2. Call `conv_dump()` to persist all logs to ChromaDB
3. Call `conv_status()` to verify buffer is empty

Do NOT end the session until these are complete!
